exercises.title: Push-Ups
exercises.description: Keep your body straight and lower yourself until chest nearly touches the floor, then push back up.

exercises.title: Squats
exercises.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squat down keeping back straight, then return.

exercises.title: Planks
exercises.description: Hold your body in a straight line on elbows and toes, keeping abs tight.

exercises.title: Burpees
exercises.description: From standing, squat, kick back to plank, return and jump up.

exercises.title: Lunges
exercises.description: Step forward with one leg, lower your hips, then return and switch.

exercises.title: Jumping Jacks
exercises.description: Jump while spreading arms and legs, return, and repeat.

exercises.title: High Knees
exercises.description: Run in place while lifting knees toward your chest quickly.

exercises.title: Arm Circles
exercises.description: Stand straight and rotate arms forward and backward in small circles.

exercises.title: Wall Sit
exercises.description: Lean against a wall and slide down until knees are at 90°, hold position.

exercises.title: Standing Side Bends
exercises.description: Stand straight and bend sideways at the waist, alternating left and right.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: We help people become stronger, healthier, and happier with simple, practical programs that fit seamlessly into everyday life. Our approach covers all aspects of wellness:
tags: Strength – Build muscle, improve posture, and increase overall power.
Cardio – Boost endurance, heart health, and energy levels.
Mobility – Enhance flexibility, joint health, and functional movement.
Nutrition – Fuel your body with easy, balanced, and delicious meal plans.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To create a supportive community where everyone feels motivated and empowered on their fitness journey, combined with data-driven coaching that adapts to every individual’s goals and fitness level. We aim to make health and wellness accessible, sustainable, and personalized, helping people achieve lasting results through the right balance of exercise, nutrition, and guidance.

AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.text:
At FitLifeHub.com, we help you take charge of your health and fitness with simple, effective solutions. Discover workouts for all fitness levels and meal prep ideas that are nutritious, delicious, and easy to follow.

Our goal is to make fitness approachable and sustainable, so you can stay motivated, track your progress, and achieve your goals. Whether you’re starting your journey or looking to level up, we provide the guidance and tools to help you live a healthier, stronger, and more energized life.
